dataset.name: retrieval
dataset.note: Synthetic, fictional posts written for this check about projects from the fictional identity catalogue (evals/identity/v1). It measures whether filtered keyword retrieval finds the labelled posts of the right project and never returns another project's or withdrawn evidence. It is small and was written alongside the retriever, so it shows the baseline behaves as designed; it is not a measure of retrieval quality on real chatter. Some queries are deliberately hard for keywords: other word forms (flooding/floods) and English queries for Hindi posts. Hindi posts write the locality in Latin letters ("Sector 102"), as many real posts do; with "सेक्टर 102" the Step 04 matcher sends the link to review (I19), which this retrieval check keeps separate.
